snippet.title: Specimen Zero - Horror (Trailer). Available on Android and iOS
snippet.description:
-Specimen Zero on iOS:  https://apps.apple.com/ch/app/specimen-zero-horror/id1574175808?l=en

-Specimen Zero on Android:  https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.specimen.zero.horror.survival

Feel the horror and fear of the dark, unlock the exits to escape!

You wake up in an unknown place and the last thing you remember is being kidnapped. But something has happened in that strange place, something out of the ordinary ... something dangerous. You must discover the way to escape. Because here, you will only find death.
